errors.text: The proposed carbon addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of high-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering.
No carbon concentration, incorporation route, consolidation schedule, or carbide precipitation treatment is specified, so the intervention is not reproducible.
The requested supporting prior evidence is absent.
The claim that carbide strengthening will preserve plasticity and machinability is unsupported and is especially uncertain because carbide formation can promote brittleness.
The processing boundaries omit the variables governing the proposed mechanism, including carbon content, precipitation temperature, carbide size, volume fraction, and spatial distribution.
